info.title: Licentivo Launch Integration API
info.description: System, account, desktop licensing, integration wizard and basic purchase APIs. This is not the full staff administration/payment-webhook API. Runtime access must still pass the official Licentivo SDK. Email verification is required only when enabled by the merchant. Custom licensing connections and customer delivery are also documented. External receiver endpoints are specified separately in external-licensing-openapi.json.

post.description: Merchant administrator authentication required. Website sessions require CSRF. HTTP SDK access defaults off and is sandbox-only. HTTPS requires a configured listener and valid certificate. Existing generated client URLs do not change automatically.

RequestID.description: Also returned in the X-Request-ID response header

access_token.description: Only returned for desktop login. Treat as secret; never put in URLs or logs.

license_key.description: For the official SDK only; never authorize access by inspecting this value.

PublicProductConfig.description: Sanitized public configuration. Signature key provenance must be verified by the merchant.

licentivo_product_id.description: Empty only when a failed check could not resolve a mapping.

allow_http.description: Included as true only for a sandbox HTTP origin after the merchant enables SDK HTTP testing. Direct code includes the language-specific opt-in.

PublicProductImport.description: Launch public product configuration, populated from the official product ID and signing public keys. Legacy JSON with empty license_key/cache_path and false allow_http is accepted and stripped. Populated secrets and unknown fields are rejected.

identity_token.description: Short-lived identity assertion, at most 120 seconds; never a runtime grant.

value.description: Sensitive; maximum 4096 UTF-8 bytes. Never log. Activation URLs must use a configured HTTPS origin.

signing_key.description: Standard Base64 of 32-128 random bytes; required on create, empty retains existing key on edit.

allow_local_http.description: Only sandbox loopback HTTP is permitted.

provider.description: Must match the instance-wide active licensing provider. Configure it with PUT /api/v1/admin/licensing/provider first.

connection_id.description: External connection UUID; required for custom_http.

default_provider.description: The single active licensing provider for all products and both environments.

api_key.description: Required for the first connection. Omit or leave empty to retain the saved server-side key.

webhook_secret.description: Optional secret of 32–256 bytes. Omit or leave empty to retain the saved secret.

body.description: A safe Markdown subset: headings, emphasis, lists, and HTTP/HTTPS or relative links. Raw HTML is displayed as text.

version.description: Expected current draft version; use 0 before the first save. Conflicting edits return POLICY_VERSION_CONFLICT.

allow_sdk_http.description: Explicit merchant-controlled HTTP SDK test opt-in. Only sandbox runtime identity requests may use HTTP; the SDK still needs an HTTP merchant origin and allow_http=true. Does not downgrade HTTPS or change Licentivo API transport.

desktopBearer.description: Opaque desktop session from auth/login with kind=desktop.

websiteCookie.name: launch_session
websiteCookie.description: Browser session. Mutations also require matching Origin and X-CSRF-Token from launch_csrf.
